_note: Voice casting for this series. voices: story-engine bible character id -> Kokoro voice (blends like "bf_alice*0.6+bf_lily*0.4" work). lexicon: names the engine mispronounces, /IPA/ or a plain respelling. Check with: node tools/narrate.mjs lantern-mender <code> --dry-run

respell._note: Gemini only: words replaced in the text sent to Gemini (Gemini has no IPA input). Kokoro uses lexicon above.

gemini._note: Gemini full-cast voices (tools/narrate.mjs --engine gemini), chosen by Ben 2026-11-09. The narrator voice is in config/tts.json gemini.narrator. style is the per-line delivery prompt.

c-ada-brannock.style: Young British woman, practical and dry, tired and wary, speaking at a natural unhurried pace

c-tobias-penhallow.style: Gruff older British man of few words, gravelly and clipped, a clockmaker, speaking at a measured pace

c-odile-fane.style: Quick, bright, chatty British market woman, warm and gossipy, but not rushed
